name: Algeria clinics & care facilities
alternateName: Cliniques et structures de soins d'Algérie
description: Clinics and proximity-care facilities from OpenStreetMap. A community-maintained extract, NOT an official registry: it mixes the public proximity tier (polycliniques, salles de soins, centres de santé) with private clinics and maternities, and coverage is partial and uneven by wilaya. It complements @geoalgeria/sante, which carries the Ministry of Health registry tier (CHU/EPH/EHS/EPSP) that is excluded here; the two describe different populations and must not be summed.
citation: OpenStreetMap: clinics & proximity-care facilities in Algeria — ODbL 1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors)
